mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmItemDetailInfoViewPopList*/ SELECT A.ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO -- 0 , DECODE(A.ITEM_STATUS, 'N', '진행 가능 상품', 'P', '단종', 'Q', '일시품절') AS ITEM_STATUS -- 1 , A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION -- 2 , A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION -- 3 , A.MAKER_NAME -- 4 , A.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO -- 5 , A.QUALITY AS QUALITY -- 6 , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_TEXT -- 7 , A.MIN_DELIVERY_LT AS MIN_DELIVERY_LT -- 8 , A.MAX_DELIVERY_LT AS MAX_DELIVERY_LT -- 9 , A.MAKE_LT AS MAKE_LT -- 10 , A.USER_PRICE AS USER_PRICE -- 11 , A.PRINT_OPT_PRICE AS PRINT_OPT_PRICE -- 12 , A.ITEM_QTY1 AS QTY1 -- 13 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE1 AS PRICE1 -- 14 , A.ITEM_QTY2 AS QTY2 -- 15 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE2 AS PRICE2 -- 16 , A.ITEM_QTY3 AS QTY3 -- 17 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE3 AS PRICE3 -- 18 , A.ITEM_QTY4 AS QTY4 -- 19 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE4 AS PRICE4 -- 20 , A.REMARK REMARK -- 21 , DECODE(A.IMG_NAME, NULL, 'NO_IMG', '/attfiles/'||A.IMG_DIR||'/'||A.IMG_NAME) AS IMG_PATH -- 22 , DECODE(A.STATUS, 'S', '요청', 'C', '게시', 'B', '반려', 'R','게시', 'A','보관', 'D','삭제','V','추천') AS STATUS -- 23 , NVL(A.D_REMARK, ' ') AS D_REMARK -- 24 , NVL(A.B_REMARK, ' ') AS B_REMARK -- 25 , DECODE(NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0),0,1,NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0)) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY -- 26 , B.ADD_COMPANY -- 27 , B.ADD_USER_NAME -- 28 , B.ADD_DATE -- 29 , B.ADD_TEL_NO -- 30 , B.ADD_EMAIL -- 31 , B.ADD_REMARK -- 32 , NVL(TRIM(B.RECV_USER_ID),'ALL') AS RECV_USER_ID -- 33 , DECODE(NVL(TRIM(B.RECV_USER_ID),'ALL'),'ALL','ALL', (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = B.RECV_USER_ID)) AS USER_NAME_LOC -- 34 , NVL(TRIM(B.RECV_DATE),'ALL') AS RECV_DATE -- 35 , NVL(TRIM(B.RECV_REMARK),'ALL') AS RECV_REMARK -- 36 FROM PRMTITEM A, PRMTSRDT B WHERE A.ITEM_NO = #{ITEM_NO} AND A.ITEM_NO = B.ITEM_NO AND B.RFQ_NO = #{RFQ_NO} AND B.STATUS ^= 'D'
